title: Lasting Legacy Pack Manifest
description: Manifest for a modpack or datapack. A manifest is either SINGLE-VERSION (has 'mc_version') or MULTI-VARIANT (has 'variants'), never both.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editor autocomplete.

id.description: Stable pack identifier. Matches the pack's folder name.

loader.description: Mod loader (e.g. fabric, forge, neoforge, quilt).

release_type.description: Release channel for the published version.

version.description: Pack version (CalVer, e.g. 26.05). Required for production single-version manifests and generated for experimental manifests

mc_version.description: Minecraft version. Used by single version modpack manifests. Mutually exclusive with 'variants'.

variants.description: For MULTI-VARIANT packs: independently-built variants published as separate versions under the same project. Publish order follows array order (last entry lands on top of the platform version list).

base.description: If true, this pack is a base that other packs may consume (e.g. SoF as the performance base). Bases cannot themselves declare 'performance_base' — no chains.

performance_base.description: ID of the pack this one consumes its performance baseline from. The referenced pack must exist in modpacks/ and must have 'base': true. Omit if this pack does not consume from a performance base.

shared_assets.description: ID of a pack that provides shared assets (e.g. 'lce-common'). The referenced pack must exist in modpacks/. Independent of 'performance_base' — a pack may set both.

allOf.description: No chains: a pack marked as a base cannot consume from another base.
